# HEM v0.8.6b1 - Interactive trend colours

- Each curve has a matching coloured label and value. Tap a label to highlight the curve and read its value directly on the graph.
- Drag the shared time marker or use the arrow keys to inspect room measurements, sensor limits, recorded targets, PID demand and device output. Missing evidence appears as a dash. Binary device reports display On or Off.
- Target ranges have separate low and high readouts. Controls from different devices keep their own colours while the dialog is open.
